mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(activity.total_duration, 0))), 0) FROM user u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, SUM(total_duration_seconds) AS total_duration FROM user_activity_session GROUP BY user_id ) activity ON u.id = activity.user_id WHERE u.status = 1

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS date, COALESCE(SUM(total_duration_seconds), 0) AS durationSeconds FROM user_activity_session WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date ASC
